verdict.rationale: LibreChat is a chat interface where natural-language prompts drive AI agents. Those agents can run code, take API actions and call MCP tools (file system, browsers, business tools), and users can invoke agents with "@" mentions in the chat input. However, the product itself is configured through UI panels, not by chatting: agents are built in the Agent Builder side panel, MCP servers are added in the MCP Settings panel, and configuration lives in the Admin Panel or librechat.yaml. Missing for 10: natural-language control of the product's own functions (creating agents, changing settings, managing conversations via chat commands), and hands-on or independent corroboration of NL-driven operation.
